parsed.reason: Perfect execution. Single warm, open question about how Little Sprouts is going ("Is Little Sprouts starting to feel like a routine yet?"). Explicitly takes pressure off ("No pressure to write back"). Doesn't assume it went well—uses neutral, exploratory language. No invented specifics about the child, no names, no ages, no pronouns, no assumptions. Plain, short, first person implied. Nothing else at all. Exactly what a friend would text.
